notes.title: Planned Release Date
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017160/0e83148bb5977278020ee21fc89c66e7c8c9ab65.gif[/img]

We decided on the release date of the game, do not miss the opportunity to buy the game on the first day of release, add the game to wishlist.

Everyone wants space sweets, We suggest you go to space after them. To get them is not so simple, you need to break the blocks with a ball, controlling a jet platform. Plus, evil aliens also want these sweets and will bother you in every way.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1176190/Space_Candy/
